scope: Six original upstream frontend packages. Singlevendor admin is an additional original web package, not a claim that its product role equals Fair merchant-web. Customer candidate copied previously; its runtime is unverified.
ui_rule: Preserve complete original Enatega UI and navigation. Only transport/session/configuration integration changes; missing backend is not permission to redesign or stub success.

customer_web.url_rule: HTTP/WS base normalized to /graphql; REST base normalized to trailing slash; missing HTTP base currently becomes relative /graphql and must instead fail configuration validation.

admin_web.url_rule: Literal BASE + graphql; configure a base ending in /, without graphql suffix.

customer_mobile.url_rule: Full GraphQL URLs; REST base requires trailing slash. MULTI mode is hardcoded upstream in all environments and needs integration-layer configuration.

merchant_mobile.url_rule: Full GraphQL URLs. MULTI mode hardcoded upstream and needs integration-layer configuration.

rider_mobile.url_rule: Full GraphQL URLs; currently fallback to upstream if absent; remove fallbacks.

graphql.websocket_library: subscriptions-transport-ws via Apollo WebSocketLink in all six clients
graphql.websocket_subprotocol: graphql-ws (legacy subscriptions-transport-ws protocol), distinct from graphql-transport-ws
graphql.requirement: Either implement audited legacy compatibility with authentication and per-subscription ownership or deliberately migrate all transport clients together while preserving UI. Merely exposing modern graphql-ws library is not protocol compatibility.
graphql.authorization_rule: Client userId/isAuth are untrusted hints; derive identity, role and tenant from verified server session. Configure exact allowed web origins and required headers; secure native token storage / HttpOnly web session bridge.
graphql.bootstrap: metricsGeneral returns experience and hehe; current original transports initialize/refresh these public access tokens. Adapt bootstrap explicitly or implement real bounded public token contract; do not fabricate metrics/token success.
graphql.refresh_contract: GraphQL REFRESH_TOKEN with variables refreshToken,userType; must map to application-bound canonical sessions without trusting supplied userType.

rest_requirements.response: success,error,data with data status,errorMessage,formattedAddress,city for admin
rest_requirements.web_proxy: Customer web /api/maps/reverse-geocode forwards to backend maps/reverse-geocode; source app/api/maps/reverse-geocode/route.ts

rest_requirements.note: Existing presentation initiates payment here; server must own order price and authenticate order owner. Provider remains unconfigured.
Current fetch lacks auth headers; integration must authenticate and enforce restaurant ownership rather than replicate insecure call.

rest_requirements.defect: Code concatenates SERVER_URL + paypal but MULTI SERVER_URL ends /graphql, producing /graphqlpaypal. Fix integration use of REST base, do not make malformed URL canonical.

media.upload: GraphQL uploadImageToS3(image: String!) { imageUrl }; base64 data URL used by chat/admin
media.requirement: Provider-neutral bounded authenticated upload, content validation, tenant ownership; persist durable media references. GraphQL operation name does not require actual S3 vendor.
media.legacy_cloudinary: Admin cloudinary.ts service POSTs FormData to configured cloudinaryUploadUrl; no default external upload account may activate.
media.managed_media: Singlevendor admin rewrites /media/<key> and public-media/<key> against configured backend (lib/utils/media.ts:1). Customer media-url helper also normalizes relative paths. Preserve returned URL contract.

navigation_and_callbacks.note: Preserve navigation shapes; configure owned deployment origins/deep-link associations and validated redirects. Browser/WebView success navigation cannot authorize payment success. No provider webhook path inferred: none audited in frontend.

hardcodes_and_configuration_blockers: Customer mobile environment.config.js MULTI all stages and store environment.ts MULTI point to aws-server-v2.enatega.com; rider fallback same. Singlevendor fallback points to enatega-multivendor-api-production-9b09.up.railway.app. Remove all active upstream endpoint fallbacks before any local frontend launch.
Admin lib/utils/constants/url.ts also contains upstream defaults; audit imports/reachability before removal.
Customer app layout.tsx:60 EmailJS CDN and :69 Clarity script hardcoded; gate trackers through approved configuration.
Customer web next.config.mjs:39 connect-src self https wss ws excludes cross-origin local http API; derive allowed configured API origin without wildcard expansion.
Country/currency/minor precision/fleet selection, provider enablement, taxes/fees/refunds must be validated versioned runtime settings; initial MY/MYR/own fleet do not restrict configuration.

current_backend_evidence.implemented: HTTP /graphql loads foundation,identity,catalog,addresses SDL. Health controller exists. This is transport existence, not Enatega operation compatibility.
current_backend_evidence.unimplemented_or_unverified: Legacy Enatega GraphQL operation parity, WS subscriptions, maps proxy, media uploads, payment sessions/callbacks and runtime configuration are not accepted implementations in this audit. No suites run in this read-only source audit.

implementation_sequence: Freeze mapping of original operation documents, input/output shapes, runtime roots and preserved routes for each app, including nested fields and subscription events.
Centralize validated HTTP/WS/REST/media/public-app origins; remove active upstream fallbacks and resolve trailing slash and PayPal REST-base defects in transport layers.
Implement runtime configuration and secure session/bootstrap compatibility; run original configuration/auth screens against real backend.
Expand catalog/merchant metadata and source contracts; integrate original discovery/menu/address flows, genuine map provider only when configured.
Implement server-priced carts/quotes/order state machine, audited configurable payment/fleet policies and immutable ledger, then payment provider sessions and verified webhook handlers.
Implement merchant acceptance, dispatch/rider state transitions and authenticated event subscriptions, then tracking/chat/uploads/notifications.
Complete remaining source operations for admin, support, reviews, favorites, coupons/referrals and finance; verify each original workflow negative paths and ownership with independent QA/security.
Run original web apps and native device workflows end to end against local backend; only verified complete original UI may lift presentation launch restriction.
